prompt:
Use case: character style-transfer, first leaf-healer concept for GameXXK.
Redraw the CHARACTER IN IMAGE1 as a clean finished project-icon full-body illustration. This new user reference supersedes the old black-haired gourd-carrying healer concept.
Image1 = primary identity, costume, silhouette and cheerful airy pose.
Image2 = recently APPROVED project rendering reference ONLY: confident clean dark contour, large coherent color blocks, restrained smooth matte shading and readable clothing construction. Do not copy the adult scroll mage's age/body, face, teal bob, scroll, brush or clothes.
Image3 = project healing gem style ONLY: strong green color masses, simplified volume and dark outline. Do not turn the girl into a gem or add a gourd.

SUBJECT TO PRESERVE:
Cute youthful wholesome leaf-sprite healer girl with soft round face, violet-magenta simple cartoon eyes and a warm smile; green rounded bob with chunky straight fringe, TWO HUGE leaf-like hair ornaments forming a sprout at the top (one upright, one angled sideways), two long green leaf-shaped side locks tied with two simple white round pom-poms near cheeks. Retain the fresh yellow-green / deep leaf-green / ivory-white / ink-black palette, tiny dull-gold edges and red cloth ties.
Same Chinese-inspired black front tabard with modest white cross-collar, short black shoulder capelet edged in thin dull gold, large soft billowing WHITE WIDE SLEEVES, leaf-green flared skirt with white scalloped underlayer, fully opaque white leg coverings, small red flat shoes with white pom-pom accents. The torso and waist are fully covered. Preserve clearly young chibi proportions, approximately 3 actual head heights excluding the tall leaves, short natural limbs and innocent cheerful charm; no adult anatomy or sexualized styling.

POSE:
A light cheerful playful pose inspired by image1, front three-quarter toward SCREEN LEFT: arms softly open, big sleeves falling naturally from the forearms; one leg extends down while the other bends gently back, knees/ankles/feet anatomically connected and separated. She can read as a light magical hop like the reference, not a contorted pose. No crossed/merged legs or strange feet. Hands may peek naturally from sleeve openings rather than being oversized or duplicated. Keep all clothing intact through the motion. Head/eyes/torso direction consistent, friendly expression.
Two broad green leaf-like trailing cloth pieces and at most two clean curved ribbon tails frame the skirt; no thin spaghetti or particle cloud.

SIMPLIFY:
Hair in 4–5 big coherent green masses, only 2–3 shades; a few broad yellow-green highlights, no speckled dots. Top leaves are clear broad leaf silhouettes with a single main vein plane, not realistic many veins.
White sleeves and skirt trim have a few LARGE rounded scallops and 2 broad shadow groups, no repeated tiny frills, dense ruffles or fuzzy fur. White pom-poms are clean round shapes with one soft shadow, not hundreds of hairs.
Black front tabard is ONE broad simple shape with ONE stylized dull-gold HERB LEAF emblem in place of the rough character-like writing, and a thin clean gold edge. Red fastening: one plain red knot plus two broad short ties, no chain of tiny bows. Keep decorative emphasis on sprout head silhouette and oversized white sleeves; the rest quiet.
A tiny herbal cue can be expressed through the front leaf emblem only. Do not add backpack, gourd, medical equipment, weapons or extra items.

PAINT:
Clean project gem-icon character finish, strong organic dark outlines, big confident matte fills and 2–3 LARGE form-defining value planes per material. Soft expressive face, simple eyes with at most one small highlight, no realistic iris. No scratchy sketch edges, fuzz, grain, tiny polygon mosaic, dense crystal facets, glossy 3D materials or diffuse watercolor blur. This is organic cloth/hair, not literal crystal.
One fully finished full-body character, complete top leaves, both sleeves, trailing cloth and both red shoes within square composition with generous safe margins. Plain uniform warm ivory background matching project review images. REMOVE reference's gray panel, rough white frame, star/sparkle and background texture. No text, labels, watermark, scene, floor shadow or other characters.
purpose: User-provided leafy sprite character redrawn as first healer review concept in the project icon style.
visual_review: Leaf-sprout head silhouette, green bob/side locks, white broad sleeves and pom-poms, black/gold leaf tabard, red ties and shoes retained; rough source repaint/gray panel replaced with clean shapes and ivory background.
